title: Madhumakkhi Ki Poori Zindagi = Sirf 1/12 Chammach Shahad!
idea: A worker honeybee makes only about 1/12 of a teaspoon of honey in her whole life, so one spoonful takes about 12 bees' lifetimes, and a pound of honey takes about 2 million flowers and 55,000 miles of flying.

lines.text: Ek madhumakkhi apni poori zindagi mein sirf 1/12 chammach shahad banati hai!
Matlab ek chammach shahad mein 12 madhumakkhiyon ki poori zindagi lagti hai!
Woh 24 km/h se udti hai, paidal insaan se lagbhag 5 guna tez!
Aadha kilo shahad ke liye madhumakkhiyan 20 lakh phoolon ka ras choosti hain!
Aur saath milke 88,000 km udti hain, Dharti ke do chakkar se zyada!
Agli baar shahad khao toh 12 zindagiyan yaad karna! Aap roz kitna khaate ho?

facts.claim: In her lifetime, a worker honeybee produces about 1/12 of a teaspoon of honey (so about 12 bee lifetimes make 1 teaspoon).
To make one pound (~454 g) of honey, the workers in a hive visit about 2 million flowers and fly about 55,000 miles (~88,500 km).
Honeybees fly at an average of about 15 mph (~24 km/h) and can reach about 20 mph.
Earth's equatorial circumference is about 40,075 km, so 88,500 km is about 2.2 trips around Earth.
Typical human walking speed is about 5 km/h, so 24 km/h is about 4.8 times faster.
